args.title: Invalidate existing bearer tokens when a password is reset
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

requireAuth only checks a JWT's signature and expiry, and password-reset/confirm never invalidates tokens issued before the reset. Add a per-user "tokens valid since" timestamp (updated in setPassword) and check it in requireAuth so bearer tokens issued before a password reset stop working immediately instead of lasting until their original expiry.

label: bug
file: src/api/auth.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Confirmed in code: JWTs issued by issueToken are stateless and requireAuth verifies only signature and expiry. password-reset/confirm changes the password but never invalidates previously issued tokens, so a captured bearer token keeps working until its own TTL elapses. Fixing this needs a revocation check (e.g. a per-user "valid since" timestamp set on password change and checked in requireAuth).
